5. IF NECESSARY, REPLACE SHIM
(a) Remove the parking brake lever, and install the correct size shim.
(b) Install the parking brake lever with a new C-washer.
(c) Remeasure the clearance.

ASSEMBLY OF PARKING BRAKE
(See page BR-26)

1. APPLY NON-MELTING TYPE GREASE ON BACKING PLATE AS SHOWN
Apply non-melting type grease to the sliding surfaces of the shoe.
